remediationWriteCode2.summary: R1/R2/R3 rebuild executed per Remediation-2. Deleted markRequestTerminal, weak claim(), handOffIntent, removedSyntheticCheckpointScaffold, and the two dead custody aliases (claimAgentSessionRequest/reclaimExpiredAgentSessionRequest). Extended terminalizeAgentSessionRequest into the single terminal writer (running+session_id and claimed+claim_token preconditions, one inbox insert each), composed through transitionAgentRunLifecycle which now re-reads the durable termination_reason and lets its disposition win over a natural-completion guess. Merged claimAgentWorkIntent into the single pending/expired-reclaim CAS the drain calls. Implemented real recoverRunningAgentSessionRequests (adopt terminal-session requests, RUNTIME_LOST orphaned-active ones). Wired boot: recoverRunningAgentSessionRequests + recoverRequestedTerminations + reapTerminalAgentWorkIntents awaited before the first drain, reaper rescheduled every 6h. Wired shutdown (server-factory dispose, best-effort) and cost_cap (session-provisioning budget-exhausted branch) termination-reason callers. Collapsed the assistant direct-create fallback into the drain (createTriggeredAgentSessionRequest now has exactly one production caller). Added the enumerated agent_work_intents/agent_session_requests durable-rows checks via hand-authored migration 0048 (this repo's post-0042 migrations are hand-authored SQL + journal entries, not drizzle-kit-regenerated -- regenerating fully recreates every table since no snapshot exists past 0042; confirmed by accidentally running it once and reverting). Fixed threads.ts/knowledge.ts sourceKind literals (thread_message/knowledge_action) so the new kind/source compatibility check doesn't reject production inserts.
realBugsFoundAndFixed: routine_run family used routine.id as agentSessionRequests.sourceId instead of the run id, so the routine lifecycle projector's WHERE routineRuns.id=sourceId could never match any real row (routine terminal facts silently never projected)

drainAgentSessionRequests looked up explicitSessionStarts by requestId both for the pre-admission model-tier read and the failure projection -- that column is only populated by drainAgentSessionRequests' own success write, so it was always null pre-admission; a real admission failure was never surfaced to the poller (start stayed 'requested' forever). Fixed by resolving the explicit-session-start id through the correlated intent's sourceId instead

agent-layer-boot.ts's failure catch called transitionAgentRunLifecycle a second time after runClaimedRequest's own catch had already terminalized (or released) the request -- a reintroduction of the W1 double-terminalize class at a different layer, surfaced as a thrown 'Unknown agent request' once the single-writer CAS was tightened. Removed the redundant second call

admitSession's concurrency check counted the request's own session (already reserved by reserveOrAdoptSession before admitSession runs) against its own agent's maxConcurrentSessions limit -- an off-by-one that permanently self-blocked every request-mediated admission for any agent at the schema default (maxConcurrentSessions=1), discovered only by the real builtin realbinary run (service-integration suites mock admitSession entirely and never exercised this path). Fixed by excluding the request's own correlated session from the count
